Cost: Part of the Militech SPECTER
Class: EQ Rocket Launcher
Range: Grenade Launcher / Missile Launcher
Pre-installed: Smart Rebuild, Telescopic Barrel with Short Tube and Long Tube (Tech Upgraded to swap barrels as half of a ROF 2 Action) (effects already included in these stats)

Only works mounted in the Militech SPECTER. The magazine can hold any number of ammo types at once; choose which to fire each attack. Its Telescopic Barrel switches between the Grenade Launcher and Missile Launcher range tables; the sheet uses DV Grenade Launcher, so change the DV table when it's on the Long Tube.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > External Linear Frames).
